title: AI in Appraisal Review: Reading the Report, Triggering the ROV, and Never Touching the Value
summary: Collateral review is where AI can help most and overstep worst. How to build an appraisal-review agent that flags quality and bias risk, routes reconsideration-of-value requests under the 2024 interagency guidance, and leaves the opinion of value to a licensed human.
